newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: HERMIS SHARES STEADY, TOP TRADE.
newsitem.headline: HERMIS SHARES STEADY, TOP TRADE.

text.p: * Official list index dipped 2.84 points to 947.31.
* Group A index rose 14.66 points to 1844.97 points
* Hermis Bank was at 215 litas, trades 2.6 million litas in blocks and 303,000 litas on the central market. Dealers said its recent price gains have come to an end for the moment.
Lithuanian shares were mixed in light trade on Friday and dealers were uncertain what direction the sluggish market would take.
The official list, which tracks the market's top five blue chips, dipped 2.84 points to 947.31 while the broader group A index rose 14.66 points to 1,844.97.
Central market turnover was 692,000 litas while block trades worth 2.97 million litas were made.

Hermis Bank was in the spotlight as it held steay at 215 litas in central market trade of 303,000 litas. In block trades, it turned over 2.6 million litas in prices ranging from 172 ltas to 213 litas.
"Hermis' recent price rise is probably over for the time being since its shares can be bought cheaply in block trades," one dealer said.
Rokishkis Cheese eased to 42.95 litas from 43 litas in central market trade of 130,000 litas.
Dealers were at a loss to explain why its price slipped and said they expected it to rebound and gain further on the strength of its promising interim results.
The market, which lacks big institutional investors, often reacts slowly to results, even those announced by transparant blue chip companies like Rokishkis.
